svg.text: SpecWM: Speculative Decoding for World Models
A fast autoregressive world model drafts K future frames; an accurate bidirectional world model verifies them all in a single pass.

g.text: causal attention · small · K sequential steps
• only sees the past ⇒ error accumulates
full attention · large · one parallel pass
every draft frame attends to all others
• scores all K drafts in one forward pass
• accept x̂t+i with prob. min(1, ptgt/pdraft)
keep the accepted prefix, replace the
first rejected frame with the target's sample
Illustrative. One target-sized forward pass = one wide block; a draft step is a thin block.
